'''2000 Calamari Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Calamari region in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Michael Josem]] of Melbourne, Australia won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] or [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (date not found; 2000 Regionals ran 1 June – 3 September and Death Star II became tournament-legal on 19 July 2000)<ref name="rl00facts">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/regionals2000/basicfacts.html Championship Circuit 2000: basic facts], Decipher (Regional Championships "June 1 - September 3"; Continental Championships "Summer Con season", Europe and Australasia "not yet determined"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231959/http://www.decipher.com:80/tournaments/regionals2000/basicfacts.html Internet Archive]</ref>
